title: Chanin bar Pinchas
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sotah 4a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.4a.3-4), on the required length of seclusion: Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira, Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah, Chanin bar Pinchas, and Pelimo each give a measure. In [Kiddushin 72a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.72a.3), “It was likewise taught: Chanin bar Pinchas says,” and so on.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Sotah reads Chanin ben Pinchas. Kiddushin reads Chanan ben Pinchas. Hyman gives bar Pinchas in both.
